## Project Overview

Moment.js is a JavaScript date library for parsing, validating, manipulating, and formatting dates. [README.md:1-20] The project is a maintained Moment.js 2.x codebase in maintenance mode, with a dependency-free runtime API and a large locale catalog. [AGENTS.md:3-14]

The visible implementation uses JavaScript with ES2015-compatible source conventions. [AGENTS.md:45-50] Build tooling includes Rollup, and the repository also uses ESLint, Prettier, Markdownlint, QUnit, NYC, and TypeScript-related tooling. [package.json] [eslint.config.js]

The primary source entry point is `src/moment.js`; the build script bundles it into `build/umd/moment.js` and `build/esm/moment.js`. [scripts/build.js:213-235] The repository also contains generated root and distribution entry points such as `moment.js`, `min/moment.min.js`, and `min/moment-with-locales.js`. [AGENTS.md:20-28] [moment.js:15-17] [min/moment.min.js:6-6]

## Setup / Installation

Development requires Git and Node.js. [CONTRIBUTING.md:60-66] The documented package manager is pnpm, with the setup guide installing pnpm `11.22.0` globally before installing repository dependencies. [CONTRIBUTING.md:60-77]

Set up a checkout and install dependencies as follows:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/moment/moment.git
cd moment
npm install --global pnpm@11.22.0
pnpm install
git checkout develop
```

[CONTRIBUTING.md:60-77]

The repository’s development dependencies include Rollup, QUnit, ESLint, Prettier, NYC, TypeScript, multiple TypeScript versions, `npm-run-all2`, and `uglify-js`. [package.json] The project has no runtime dependencies. [AGENTS.md:45-50]

No local application environment variables are documented in the supplied evidence. The CI configuration does reference `FOSSA_API_KEY` and `NPM_TOKEN` for release or license-publishing workflows, but these are CI secrets rather than documented local setup variables. [.github/workflows/fossa.yml] [.github/workflows/release.yml]

## Running Locally

Run the full validation workflow with:

```bash
pnpm validate
```

The repository documents this as the command that runs tests and lint checks. [CONTRIBUTING.md:60-77] The individual development commands include `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:watch`, `pnpm test:coverage`, `pnpm test:typescript`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format`, and `pnpm build`. [CONTRIBUTING.md:106-129]

The package scripts define the main commands as follows:

- `pnpm test` runs `node scripts/test.js`. [package.json]
- `pnpm build` runs `node scripts/build.js`. [package.json]
- `pnpm lint` runs the ESLint, Markdownlint, month-parse, and Prettier checks. [package.json]
- `pnpm test:coverage` runs the tests through NYC and produces an LCOV report. [package.json]
- `pnpm test:typescript` runs declaration tests across multiple TypeScript versions. [package.json]

To run a focused test, use the repository’s `--only` convention, for example:

```bash
pnpm test -- --only=locale/<locale>
```

[AGENTS.md:36-44] The test runner accepts comma-separated selections and can select the `moment` or `locale` test groups. [scripts/test.js:23-41]

The build produces UMD and ESM Moment bundles, locale bundles, and combined locale artifacts under `build/`. [scripts/build.js:213-277] The supplied evidence does not specify a local development server or HTTP port; this repository’s documented local workflow is command-line based rather than a server-start workflow. [CONTRIBUTING.md:106-129]

## Project Structure

- `src/` contains the authoritative implementation source. [AGENTS.md:15-18]
- `src/lib/` contains core behavior split into modules for creation, parsing, formatting, durations, Moment methods, units, and utilities. [AGENTS.md:15-18] [src/lib/create/local.js:3-5] [src/lib/duration/add-subtract.js:14-21] [src/lib/units/month.js:267-279]
- `src/moment.js` is the main source entry used by the build and test bundlers. [scripts/build.js:213-235] [scripts/test.js:44-68]
- `src/locale/` contains locale definitions, which the build script discovers and bundles into locale outputs. [CONTRIBUTING.md:78-105] [scripts/build.js:213-235]
- `src/test/moment/` contains core Moment tests, while `src/test/locale/` contains locale tests. [AGENTS.md:15-18] [scripts/test.js:15-41]
- `src/test/helpers/` contains shared test helpers such as iteration, object-key, and daylight-saving-time utilities. [src/test/helpers/each.js:1-6] [src/test/helpers/object-keys.js:3-17] [src/test/helpers/dst.js:3-8]
- `scripts/` contains build, test, lint-related, release, locale, benchmark, and TypeScript-package tooling. [package.json] [scripts/build.js:73-105] [scripts/test.js:44-120]
- `benchmarks/` contains benchmark implementations consumed by `scripts/benchmark.js`. [scripts/benchmark.js:14-36] [benchmarks/compare.js:15-22]
- `moment.d.ts` and `ts3.1-typings/moment.d.ts` contain handwritten TypeScript declarations for different consumer/compiler generations. [AGENTS.md:28-34] [moment.d.ts:443-460] [ts3.1-typings/moment.d.ts:514-546]
- `typing-tests/legacy/` and `typing-tests/modern/` contain TypeScript test configurations. [typing-tests/legacy/tsconfig.json] [typing-tests/modern/tsconfig.json]
- `build/` and `coverage/` are disposable generated outputs, while the root `moment.js`, `locale/`, `dist/`, and `min/` files are generated release artifacts. [AGENTS.md:20-28]
- `.github/workflows/` contains CI, coverage, runtime-compatibility, timezone, pull-request, release, and license-scan workflows. [.github/workflows/pull-request.yml] [.github/workflows/ci.yml]

## Testing

The test framework is QUnit. The test script bundles the selected source tests with Rollup and invokes the QUnit command-line runner with `scripts/qunit-reporter.js`. [scripts/test.js:83-120] [scripts/qunit-reporter.js:2-31]

Tests are located under `src/test/moment/` for core behavior and `src/test/locale/` for locale behavior. [AGENTS.md:15-18] The test runner discovers JavaScript files in those directories and converts them into test names before bundling them. [scripts/test.js:15-41]

Run the complete test suite with:

```bash
pnpm test
```

[CONTRIBUTING.md:106-129] Run focused tests with the `--only` option, such as:

```bash
pnpm test -- --only=moment/create
pnpm test -- --only=locale/<locale>
```

[AGENTS.md:36-44] [scripts/test.js:23-41]

Coverage is available with:

```bash
pnpm test:coverage
```

This command runs the test suite through NYC and generates an LCOV report. [package.json] The coverage workflow reports `coverage/lcov.info` to Coveralls. [.github/workflows/coverage.yml]

TypeScript declaration checks are available with:

```bash
pnpm test:typescript
```

The command runs separate tests for legacy and modern declaration configurations across multiple TypeScript versions. [package.json] [typing-tests/legacy/tsconfig.json] [typing-tests/modern/tsconfig.json]

The visible testing patterns use QUnit `test` blocks with assertions such as `assert.equal`, `assert.ok`, and `assert.deepEqual`; tests also cover deprecation warnings, parsing and formatting round trips, locales, durations, UTC behavior, and timezone offsets. [src/test/moment/create.js:2459-2469] [src/test/moment/calendar.js:8-19] [src/test/moment/duration.js:50-76] [src/test/moment/utc_offset.js:879-895] Locale changes are expected to include matching unit tests under `src/test/locale/`. [CONTRIBUTING.md:24-37]
